第一卷初临异世 第一章 赶上穿越潮流了？

刘枫从昏迷的黑暗中醒来，双眼微睁，入眼处一片翠绿，随着微风摇摆不定。

转了转头，一丝阳光正从树林茂密的叶子的缝隙中射将下来，星星点点的照在脑中一片糨糊的刘枫身上。

晃了晃脑袋，有些愣然的看着周围陌生的景色，许久之后，脑袋似乎清明了一点的刘枫“嚯”的坐起身来。

“啊”，一声惨嚎响起，惊起一群飞鸟，刘枫重重的倒了下去，只觉得全身上下的肌肉就象在被无数纲针穿梭一般，巨痛难忍。

冷汗从额头淌水般的流下，嘴中不断的吸着凉气，好半晌之后，痛感才稍然退去。

重重的出了口气，躺在地上不敢再乱动弹，闭上眼睛，脑中不断回忆着。。。回忆着。。。

“我不是在网吧和同学比赛魔兽3C吗？，刚刚把人物选好，还是如同往常的剑圣BM，然后网吧停电，电脑爆炸，再然后。。。。就晕了？”

“靠”，没有头绪的刘枫，只能低声咒骂。

后来到底发生了什么事情？我怎么到这里来了？这是什么地方？

一连串的迷问让刘枫的脑袋顿时大了好几圈。。。。。

“难道遭绑架了？”刘枫郁闷不已。但随既便推翻了这荒唐的理由。

“我靠，我一个垃圾大学的垃圾学生，有个屁的东西值得人家绑架，全身上下加起来都凑不够1000块钱”

“哎呀，难道是那位昨天在学校里见到的从“侏罗纪公园”跑出来的恐龙后代做的？她不是说她男人是什么。什么“天上地下唯我独尊帮”的老大吗？说要叫人砍我，难道是被他们绑去了？”

“哎哟，痛死我了，靠，贼老天，我TM的又没做过什么伤天害理的事情，还偶尔扶老婆婆过马路，虽然。。。。虽然有时候弄错了方向，但到底也是一片好心啊。”

“你TM的是高度近视加青光眼吗？眼睛不好你去做个视网膜手术嘛。”

骂骂咧咧了许久之后，感觉喉咙有些干涩了，刘枫这才歇止了下来，只有先恢复身体，才能知道自己到底到了什么地方，发生了什么事。

动了动手指，酸麻的感觉已经减弱了许多，渐渐的弯起身来，虽然还是有点痛，但却已并不是不能忍受了，慢慢的挪到一颗巨树边，刘枫眦着牙蹲了下来。

很快的，刘枫的眉头狠狠的皱了起来：“我靠,怎么可能，这什么树啊？怎么有这么厚的甲壳？难道是最新品种？地球上，没听说过有这么古怪的树木啊，这到底是哪儿啊？”

满脑子的迷团，把刘枫本来就已经很大的头又搞大了一圈。。。

使劲甩了甩头，双手在太阳穴轻轻的揉了揉，心中不断转着念头，突然回忆着之前的怪异情形，心头猛的不由一颤，“难道这不是地球？”

被这强大的念头骇得双手抽风的刘枫，不由在心中哀嚎道“不会吧，难道我竟然穿越了？”。

虽然这个念头的确有些貌似强大，但是凭借在地球上混迹幻侠论坛，而锻炼成的超级强悍神经，刘枫在几分钟后已经渐渐相信了这个事实，不然用别的道理也实在说不清这离奇的场景。

“想不到如今正流行的穿越潮流，竟然被我赶上了，呜，我还真是强悍啊”刘枫苦笑不得。

“也罢，也罢，穿越了就穿越了吧，反正在地球上也是一无所成，整天荤荤噩噩度日，就跟一行尸没什么俩样，在这异界也许会过得更好些吧！！”刘枫很快的调整好了思想。

“现在，先出了这森林，再做打算吧，希望这异界比较好混吧，再怎么说我也是承载着新文化的新人类啊，不至于混得太差吧”

刘枫抹了把头上的汗水，嘴里不停的咒骂:“妈的，这什么鬼森林啊，走了这么久，都还没看见出口，这什么时候是个头啊？”

“靠，不走了，累死爷了”，找了一个稍显干净的地方，拍拍屁股坐了下去.

抬头四处望了望，由于森林树叶茂盛，并没有多少阳光能照射下来，整个森林看起来，气氛有些阴森，再配合者周围看起来似在张牙舞爪的树枝，还真是有几分恐怖电影起气氛。

“咕”刘枫咽了口唾沫，觉得背心处似乎已经湿透了，小声的自语道“这里怎么好象很恐怖的样子啊？我靠，在这里拍恐怖电影的话，连背景都不用准备了，直接采用现成的”。

突然一阵似狼叫的嚎叫声响起，听声音离刘枫这里似乎并不远。

刘枫连滚带爬的从地上站了起来，双眼紧盯着嚎叫声传过来的方向，冷汗从额头慢慢出现，流进眼里，好酸，顾不上搽拭，迅速在身下捡起一跟略显粗大的树枝，剔掉上面的叶条，双手紧握，这可是现在生命的保障，刘枫可不敢空手就和一头野兽拼斗，他不是传说中的武松，更不是地球牛人施瓦辛格，他只是一个平凡到了极点的学生而已，虽然有点二头肌，可是那却是为了泡美眉而锻炼的，中看不中用。

虽然不知道自己这“外来人口”对这里的原住居民有没有吸引力，但他不会为了这个问题去专门找一头野兽兄弟深度研究一下。

咆哮声越来越近了，刘枫似乎都已经从空气中闻到了腥臭的味道，黝黑的森林阴影之中，慢慢的出现了一对赤红的眼睛，杀意毫不遮掩的从中溢出，随着越来越近的距离，终于看清了这头野兽的全貌，刘枫现在敢肯定的拍着xiōng部对大家骄傲的说：“我他妈的真的穿越了，愿幻侠写穿越文的大大全被雷被劈翻，丢到异界去，让他们去试试那感觉。”

这是一头类狼的野兽，可是却比狼高了许多，足有一米多高，额头上还长有一只独角，泛着黝黑的颜色，嘴中雪白锋利的牙齿，让刘枫很想问一下：“你到底用的是什么牙膏？为什么有如此好的效果。”

所谓牙好，胃口就好，很显然这个独角狼的胃口非常的棒，哟，你看，它都流口水了咦。

腥臭的诞水从嘴角不断的滴落，赤红的双眼死死的盯住刘枫，显然不怀好意。

刘枫现在双退是一个劲的乱抖，要不是紧靠在树干上，可能已经一屁股瘫在地上了，手心里的汗把木棍都涂上了一层，冰凉滑腻。

独角狼似乎很喜欢此时面前猎物的惊慌表情，因为若在平常的话，遇到别的猛兽的话，自己也是这个样子，谁叫自己是这里最弱小的呢，所以为了表示这个猎物的配合，它勾了勾嘴角送给了刘枫一个自认为比较“和善”的微笑。

但好象它与人类的审美观点不同，所以表达出来的意思也是天差地别。

刘枫看着独角狼嘴叫勾起的笑容，让本来就极其凶恶的兽脸上更添了一分了狰狞。心中不由哭嚎“妈的，这怪物还会笑？不过笑得还真TM的恐怖。这里的生物智商都这么高？呜，妈勒，偶要回地球，这里不好玩啊。”

在害怕之极后，心中却突然莫名的涌出一阵怒气，“哇靠，你想吃劳资，先问问大爷手中的大棒答应不答应”，举起木棍朝独角狼狠狠的挥舞着，凶神恶煞的吼道，期望这怪物能被自己那临时现出的“王者之气”所震摄。

不过刘少爷貌似好象没把“王者之气”练到家，这番气势的表露落在独角狼的眼里却成了赤果裸的挑衅，独角狼顿时不乐意了，你说你一个小废物，杂这么猖狂勒？仰头狂吼一声，朝刘枫急速的扑去，锋利的爪牙在空中闪着耀眼的青光。

刘枫凭借良好的视力，看准了独角狼的扑点，小退一步，抡着木棍就狠狠的朝它头上砸去。

独角狼眼中闪过一丝嘲讽，双爪轻轻挥舞，木棍应声断成了几截。

刘枫傻了，接连后退了好几步，躲过了独角狼的第一轮攻击，眼看独角狼又要扑来。

刘枫顿时大怒，高声猛喝道：“畜生，休要猖狂，看洒家如何治你”。

独角狼被这突如其来的高音震得头脑发晕，停下了攻击，前爪微低，随时再度准备出击。

见独角狼停止了攻击后，刘枫双脚分开，双手提在胸前，面色肃穆，似乎马上就要爆发小宇宙一般，独角狼看着刘枫如此这般气势，不敢贸然进攻，退后几步，摆出防御的姿态。

刘枫双目怒瞪，口中暴喝:“闪。”

音还未落，双脚已带着身体朝后飞奔而去，迅速消失在森林黝影里，留下一头被刘枫的绝招震撼得傻傻独角狼。

Volume 1: First arrival in a different world, Chapter 1: Are you catching up on the time travel trend?

Liu Feng woke up from the darkness of coma, his eyes were slightly opened, and the area in his eyes was emerald green, swaying with the breeze.

Turning his head, a ray of sunlight was shining down from the gaps in the dense leaves of the forest, shining little by little on Liu Feng, whose mind was a mess.

Shaking his head, he stared blankly at the unfamiliar scenery around him. After a long time, Liu Feng, whose head seemed to be a little clearer, sat up with an "ooh".

"Ah", a miserable howl sounded, startling a flock of birds, and Liu Feng fell heavily. He felt as if the muscles in his body were being shuttled by countless needles, and the pain was unbearable.

Cold sweat flowed down from his forehead like water, and he kept breathing cold air in his mouth. After a long while, the pain subsided slightly.

He let out a heavy breath, lay on the ground and didn't dare to move any more. He closed his eyes and kept thinking about it in his mind...Remembering...

"Wasn't I playing Warcraft 3C with my classmates in the Internet cafe? I just selected the character, and it was still the same Juggernaut BM as usual, and then the power went out in the Internet cafe, the computer exploded, and then... I fainted?"

"Fuck", Liu Feng, who had no clue, could only curse in a low voice.

What happened next?How did I get here?What is this place?

A series of confusing questions made Liu Feng's head suddenly grow several times.....

"Have you been kidnapped?" Liu Feng was depressed.But this absurd reason was overturned at once.

"Damn it, I'm a rubbish student from a rubbish university. I have something worth kidnapping. I can't even collect 1,000 yuan for my whole body."

"Oh, is it the descendant of the dinosaur who ran away from "Jurassic Park" that I saw in school yesterday? Didn't she say who her man is? Is he the boss of the "The Only One in the World"? He said he wanted someone to kill me, was he kidnapped by them?"

"Ouch, it hurts me to death. Damn it, God, I haven't done anything harmful to God. I even occasionally helped the old lady cross the road, although... even though I sometimes went in the wrong direction, I still had good intentions after all."

"Are you suffering from high myopia and glaucoma? If your eyes are not good, why don't you go for retinal surgery?"

After cursing for a long time, his throat felt a little dry, and Liu Feng stopped. Only by recovering his body could he know where he was and what happened.

He moved his fingers, and the soreness and numbness had weakened a lot. He gradually bent over. Although it was still a little painful, it was not unbearable. He slowly moved to a giant tree, and squatted down with his teeth clenched.

Soon, Liu Feng frowned fiercely: "Holy crap, how is that possible? What kind of tree is this? Why does it have such a thick carapace? Is it the latest species? I have never heard of such a weird tree on earth. Where is this?"

The confusion in his head made Liu Feng's already big head even bigger...

Shaking his head vigorously, he gently rubbed his temples with his hands. Thoughts kept spinning in his mind. Suddenly he recalled the strange situation before, and his heart trembled violently, "Isn't this the earth?"

Liu Feng, who was so frightened by this powerful thought that his hands twitched, couldn't help but wailed in his heart, "No way, could it be that I actually traveled through time?"

Although this idea does seem to be powerful, Liu Feng gradually believed this fact after a few minutes thanks to the super strong nerves he had developed by hanging out in the Fantasy Forum on Earth. Otherwise, he would not be able to explain this bizarre scene using other reasons.

"I didn't expect that I would catch up with the popular time-travel trend nowadays. Wow, I'm really strong." Liu Feng couldn't help but laugh bitterly.

"No matter, no matter, just go through time travel. Anyway, you will achieve nothing on the earth. You will live a miserable life all day long, just like a group of corpses. Maybe you will live a better life in this other world!!" Liu Feng quickly adjusted his thoughts.

"Now, let's get out of the forest first, and then make plans. I hope this other world will be easier to get along with. After all, I am also a new human being carrying a new culture, so I won't be too bad at getting along."

Liu Feng wiped the sweat from his head and kept cursing: "Damn it, what kind of ghost forest is this? I've been walking for so long and I still haven't seen the exit. When will this end?"

"Damn, I can't leave anymore, I'm so exhausted." I found a slightly cleaner place, patted my butt and sat down.

I looked up and looked around. Due to the lush leaves of the forest, not much sunlight could shine down. The entire forest seemed to have a somewhat gloomy atmosphere. Coupled with the surrounding branches that seemed to be clawing and clawing, it really had the atmosphere of a horror movie.

"Gu" Liu Feng swallowed and felt that his vest seemed to be soaked. He whispered to himself, "Why does it look so scary here? Damn it, if you shoot a horror movie here, you don't even need to prepare the background, just use the ready-made one."

Suddenly, a howl like a wolf sounded, and it seemed that the sound was not far from Liu Feng's place.

Liu Feng crawled up from the ground, his eyes fixed on the direction where the howling came from. Cold sweat slowly appeared from his forehead and flowed into his eyes. He was so sore that he didn't bother to wipe it. He quickly picked up a slightly thick branch under his body, picked off the leaves on it, and held it tightly with both hands. This is nowWith his life guaranteed, Liu Feng didn't dare to fight a beast with bare hands. He was not the legendary Wu Song, nor was he Schwarzenegger, the most powerful person on earth. He was just an extremely ordinary student. Although he had some biceps, they were exercised for the purpose of attracting girls, and they were of no use.

Although he didn't know whether his "foreign population" would be attractive to the original residents here, he would not go find a beast brother to conduct in-depth research on this issue.

The roar was getting closer and closer, and Liu Feng seemed to have smelled the fishy smell in the air. In the dark shadow of the forest, a pair of red eyes slowly appeared, and murderous intent overflowed from them without any concealment. As the distance got closer and closer, he finally sawAfter seeing the whole picture of this beast, Liu Feng now patted his chest with certainty and said proudly to everyone: "I really fucking traveled through time. I hope that all the time-traveling articles written by Huanxia will be struck over by lightning and thrown into another world, so that they can try what it feels like."

This is a wolf-like beast, but it is much taller than a wolf, more than one meter tall. It has a single horn on its forehead, which is dark in color. The white and sharp teeth in its mouth make Liu Feng want to ask: "What kind of toothpaste are you using? Why is it so effective."

As the saying goes, good teeth mean good appetite. Obviously, this one-horned wolf has a very good appetite. Look, it is drooling.

The smelly water dripped from the corner of his mouth, and his red eyes stared at Liu Feng, obviously with bad intentions.

Liu Feng was trembling wildly as he retreated. If he hadn't been leaning against the tree trunk, he might have collapsed on the ground. The sweat in his palms coated the wooden stick with a layer of coldness and smoothness.

The unicorn wolf seems to like the panic expression of the prey in front of it at this time, because if it normally encounters other ferocious beasts, it will look like this. Who can say that it is the weakest here, so in order to show the cooperation of the prey, it raised the corner of its mouth and gave Liu Feng a smile that it thought was more "kind".

But it seems that it is different from human aesthetic point of view, so the meaning expressed is also very different.

Liu Feng watched the unicorn wolf growl with a smile, which made the already extremely ferocious beast's face even more ferocious.I couldn't help but cry in my heart, "Damn it, this monster can still laugh? But the laugh is really scary. Are the creatures here with such high IQs? Oh, Mom, I want to go back to Earth, it's not fun here."

After being extremely frightened, an inexplicable burst of anger suddenly welled up in his heart, "Oh shit, you want to take advantage of your labor, first ask the uncle if you agree with the big stick in his hand." He raised the wooden stick and waved it fiercely at the unicorn wolf, roaring fiercely, hoping that the monster would be shocked by his temporary "kingly aura".

However, Young Master Liu didn't seem to have mastered the "king's spirit". This display of momentum became a naked provocation in the eyes of the wolf. The wolf was immediately unhappy. You said you are a little loser, how can you be so arrogant?He raised his head and roared wildly, and rushed towards Liu Feng quickly, his sharp claws flashing a dazzling green light in the air.

With his good eyesight, Liu Feng spotted the wolf's attack point, took a small step back, swung the wooden stick and hit it hard on the head.

There was a trace of ridicule in the eyes of the unicorn wolf, and he waved his claws gently, and the stick broke into several pieces.

Liu Feng was dumbfounded. He took several steps back and dodged the first round of the wolf's attack. He saw that the wolf was about to pounce again.

Liu Feng suddenly became furious and shouted loudly: "Beast, don't be so arrogant. Let's see how the Sa family treats you."

The one-horned wolf was dizzy by the sudden high-pitched sound. He stopped attacking and lowered his front paws slightly, ready to strike again at any time.

After seeing that the one-horned wolf stopped attacking, Liu Feng spread his legs and held his hands in front of his chest. His face was solemn, as if a small universe was about to explode. The one-horned wolf saw Liu Feng's momentum and did not dare to attack rashly. He took a few steps back and assumed a defensive posture.

Liu Feng's eyes glared angrily, and he yelled: "Dodge."

Before the sound even fell, his feet were already flying backwards with his body, and he quickly disappeared into the dark shadows of the forest, leaving behind a lone wolf that was stunned by Liu Feng's trick.
